description: Template prompts for skill sound generation by visual category
usage: Templates provide base prompts and modifiers for generating consistent skill sounds. Combine basePrompt with appropriate modifiers based on skill properties.

fire.name: Fire Magic
fire.basePrompt: Fantasy arcane flames with crackling magical heat and mystical fire energy

modifiers.low_power: small flickering flame with brief contained warmth
modifiers.mid_power: blazing fire burst with intense magical burning
modifiers.high_power: roaring inferno eruption with overwhelming mystical heat
modifiers.aoe: spreading fire wave with multiple ignition points
modifiers.projectile: soaring fire bolt with trailing arcane sparks
modifiers.sustained: persistent magical flames with continuous burning energy
